name: kiln-engine
description: Create, review and revise editable 3D assets, with private saved revisions and GLB downloads.

interface.longDescription: Create procedural 3D assets from a brief, review rendered views, revise their editable source, and save private versions in your Kiln account. Reopen saved work and download GLBs, source and editable bundles. Your agent authors the source; Kiln evaluates and renders it. Connect with Google or GitHub. Hosted rendering and storage use account quotas. Experimental geometry helpers are labeled in the catalog.
defaultPrompt: Create and save an editable reading lamp.
Revise a saved asset and give me its GLB.

publication.release_notes: Initial hosted integration for creating, reviewing, saving and revising private editable 3D assets with the Kiln 1.0 engine.
